verdict.rationale: Resend documents webhooks for real-time email event notifications and says users can 'monitor delivery events'. It also offers an API to retrieve links clicked in a broadcast, and a community user confirms webhooks with logging. However, nothing in the pack documents explicit open/click tracking for individual transactional emails or an API to query a per-message event timeline, so the 'what happened to this email?' query is only implied via webhooks and dashboard activity. Missing for 10: documented open/click tracking configuration, a per-message event history/retrieve-email API, and independent hands-on corroboration of event querying.
